shortDescription: The "Over" option in Polymarket's "Wake Forest O/U 2.5" submarket for the "Miami (FL) vs. Wake Forest" event fell sharply from 35% one hour ago to 20%, a 15-point drop. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflects a sudden swing in the prediction market and may be affected by breaking news.
